name: WHOIS Lookup
description: Look up the registration details of a domain name or IP address.

hints.query: Give either a domain or an address; when both are present the address wins.
hints.output: RDAP over HTTPS is tried first, then the whois port 43 as a fallback; both need network access.

faq.q: Why can the lookup come back empty?
faq.a: Usually the target has no RDAP service and the whois server is unreachable; the domain may also be unregistered or already deleted.

faq.q: Why is there no registrant identity?
faq.a: Most registries hide personal details under privacy rules and only keep the country or region.
No. The server keeps nothing about the query and only records anonymous call counters.
